scope: Software builds, actual-source host checks, mocked-controller browser flows and simulated-flight missions. No physical phone, controller, motor, radio or flight validation.
packageEvidence: Downloaded successful full-run artifacts are byte-identical to the firmware/APK committed at verifiedPackageCommit. No firmware, Android source or embedded mobile assets changed between that package commit and finalWebSourceCommit.
checks: Both pinned ESP32-C3 and XIAO ESP32-C6 profiles compile; image/chip/version, dual OTA slots, slot capacity and factory/application equality verified.
Android DEX, manifest, API levels, ZIP alignment, development signature and bundled mobile UI/transport equality verified.
Project JSON/JS/file references, local 3D assets, 22 offline Python packages and sealed release inventory verified.
Actual-source C++ flight math, RC receiver timing/endpoints/gaps/arming and setup/training output inhibition checked on the host.
Java native lease gate and 50 Hz RC UDP stream tested; browser transport, reconnect, output/camera cleanup and upload guards pass.
Guided setup, floating neutral-at-touch joysticks, live input ownership, AP/STA routing, short-gap recovery, hard-loss/manual rearm and mobile flows pass.
All 10 teaching missions checked for task/landing completion, obstacle crashes, gusts, LED/payload objectives and retry behavior.

Learning workspace browser checks navigation, individual I/O tools, merged connection/upgrades, unavailable sensor gauges, software 3D, locks, app RC-driven virtual flight, stale pause, neutral resume and page-exit STOP.
Final browser scenario proves an unready controller's placeholder 0-degree attitude is hidden after a valid measured sample; responsive views remain inside the viewport.
firstUse: Use matching V18.3.65 firmware and APK. Remove propellers for setup, motor/ESC tests and app/PPM training. Complete physical bench/device verification before flight.
